title: Genesis scATAC parameters, from raw 10x reads

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Sample sheet, references, and run locations.

input.errorMessage: Supply exactly one input TSV with --input INPUT.tsv

run_name.description: Run folder under workspace. Defaults to the input sheet's basename without .tsv.

workspace.description: Root for run folders holding work, and published output and trace files unless persist_dir is set.

persist_dir.description: Long-term storage for published output and trace files, in persist_dir/run_name; work stays in the workspace. Default: the run folder in the workspace.

queue.description: Slurm queue: the partition with the slurm (default regular) and sherlock (default normal) profiles, the QOS with nersc (default shared).

download_batch_size.description: Samples fetched by each DOWNLOAD task; up to eight tasks run at once.

cell_options.title: Cell calling
cell_options.description: Used for rows whose cells_url is -.

scatac_min_fragments.description: Least nuclear fragments for a barcode to count as a cell (ArchR's default).

scatac_max_cells.description: Keep at most this many cells, the barcodes with the most nuclear fragments; 0 for no limit.

trace_timestamp.description: Timestamp for trace file names. Set automatically.

run_dir.description: workspace/run_name. Set automatically; use --workspace and --run_name instead.

publish_base.description: Where output and trace files go: persist_dir/run_name, or run_dir. Set automatically; use --persist_dir instead.
